stemMd: Which event occurred first: the Schuman Declaration, the signing of the Treaties of Rome, or the end of the Second World War in Europe?

options.label: B
options.textMd: The three events cannot be ordered.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The end of the Second World War in Europe

options.label: E
options.textMd: All occurred in the same year.

explanationMd: The war in Europe ended in May 1945. Schuman presented his proposal in May 1950, and the Treaties of Rome were signed in March 1957. The sequence places integration in its postwar setting.

distractorRationale.b: Their historical dates establish the order.
